content.short: City Holder is a city-building simulation game on Telegram where players manage virtual cities and earn tokens.
content.description: City Holder is an engaging city-building simulation game built as a Telegram Mini App on the TON blockchain. It allows players to take on the role of a city manager, strategically developing their virtual urban centers by constructing buildings, managing resources, and completing social tasks. The game rewards players with tokens for their management skills and social engagement, combining the depth of traditional simulation games with the incentives of Web3. City Holder provides an immersive and rewarding experience for players looking to build and earn in the TON ecosystem.
content.meta: Build your dream city and earn rewards in City Holder on TON. Play the top sim on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
